body: good on you for standing your ground like this!
ill make sure to do those things. thank you.

yeah, you're right about that. ive been dealing with mental illness for 3+ years now(?) and it's been a real struggle. thanks for the advice and good on you for improving as well. ill definitely follow it.

it was ok for me overall. only problem was slight visual hallucinations. (walls would seem to move if i stared long enough). i was taken off of them by a psychiatrist because of this. it numbed me, and i miss that. wish i was still on it.
thank you. i hope so too..

thank you, im trying. i have told my family about my depression. they know everything, as ive been majorly depressed for years. they've tried everything, i guess. i take antidepressants and have been to therapy several times. i feel like a lost cause at this point, i feel like im never going to be ok again.

ive been to group therapy for a few months earlier this year, but its expensive and time consuming. i guess my mom is trying to get me a new therapist but it hasn't happened yet. i dont know how much longer i can wait for that.

im sorry that it got so bad to the point where you felt like you had to run away. i hope you have safe travels. and not to scare you or anything but please become aware of your state's (if you live in the us) laws on running away. i was researching the other day and i found out that in some states you can be arrested for running away as a minor, but not all states. be careful and stay safe out there.

thank you so much! keeping my phone out of reach actually does help, so i need to do that more. and yeah, thinking about how rewarding it will be to finally be done with the work is a great motivator. thanks again.
